title: A separated presheaf injects into its plus construction
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $\mathcal G$ be a separated presheaf of sets on $\mathcal C$: for every covering $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$, the map $\mathcal G(U)\to\prod_i\mathcal G(U_i)$ is injective (Stacks Sites, Definition 00WA). Let $\mathcal G^+$ be the plus construction and $\theta_{\mathcal G}:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G^+$ the canonical map [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction]. Then $\theta_{\mathcal G,U}:\mathcal G(U)\to\mathcal G^+(U)$ is injective for every object $U$. This is the injectivity clause of Stacks Sites, Theorem 00WB (theorem-plus), part (2).

source.place: Sites, Definition 00WA (definition-separated) and Theorem 00WB (theorem-plus), part (2), proof of item-sheaf
